name: AMD Halo Grader Cold Probe
goal: Run one live timed probe against AMD Halo reproducing grader.py's default request shape; record pass/fail and close.

tasks.name: Run cold probe and record findings
tasks.description: Confirm deployed grader model, curl AMD Halo /v1/chat/completions with grader.py's default thinking-suppression fields, evaluate pass/fail, write findings doc, stage it. No code changes.

steps.expected: backend:openai, openai.base_url:http://100.76.144.47:8080/v1, openai.model:gemma4-26b-a4b, no spots.grader override, timeout_seconds:600

steps.description: Issue the probe request using grader.py's default suppression fields
steps.command: curl -sS -m 30 -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code} TIME:%{time_total}\n" -X POST http://100.76.144.47:8080/v1/chat/completions -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer ollama" -d '{"model":"gemma4-26b-a4b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly one word: ok"}],"max_tokens":16,"temperature":0.1,"reasoning_effort":"none","chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":false}}'
steps.expected: HTTP:200, finish_reason:stop, no reasoning_content field, TIME <= 15.0

steps.description: Evaluate pass/fail against the four conditions: HTTP 200, finish_reason stop, no reasoning_content, TIME <= 15.0
steps.expected: PASS if all four hold; FAIL with the specific violated condition otherwise

steps.description: Write findings doc with actual Step 1/2/3 output and conclusion
steps.expected: docs/plans/2026-09-15-amd-halo-cold-probe-findings.md created with verbatim evidence and verdict
